title: centaurium umbellatum subsp. capitatum
intro: Centaurium umbellatum subsp. capitatum, commonly known as Blue Mountain bitterling or Blue Mountain rampion, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium umbellatum subsp. capitatum include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help relieve respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and amarogentin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
